summary: Added a root `pnpm web:update` script that rebuilds the frontend bundle and restarts the Gizmo web daemon, then diagnosed why the Tailscale IP wasn't reachable after the user ran it.
decisions: Use `pnpm -C apps/app build && pnpm web:server restart` as the new root script so a build failure short-circuits before the restart, leaving the running instance untouched.
Build before restart (not restart then build) so the daemon is the last step and a failed build never takes the server down.
Do not put `//` comments inside package.json — JSON does not support them and it caused `pnpm web:server status` to fail with a parse error (initial commit was amended to remove them).
User must run `pnpm web:update` from a normal terminal at the repo root, not from inside a Gizmo session, because the restart drops the agent server the session lives on.
errors: First version of the edit added `//` comments inside `package.json`, producing "Expected double-quoted property name in JSON at position 869" and breaking `pnpm web:server status`; fixed by removing the comments and amending commit.
